title: What's new in v2.11.6
summary: Edit your floor plan faster: change many walls at once, and move APs with a right-click.

steps.title: Signal Map Toolbox
steps.listLabel: Edit your floor plan faster: change many walls at once, and move APs with a right-click
steps.body:
The **Signal Map** now has a toolbox under the zoom buttons: **Pan**, **Select**, **Draw Layout**, **Undo**, and AP placement.

With **Select**, drag a box over walls, then click one to change all their materials at once. **Right-click** an AP to **Move** or **Remove** it.
